purpose: Representative unseen engineering goals used to validate that the Electronics agent can retrieve cookbook knowledge, use real application tools, identify capability gaps, and produce evidence-backed engineering conclusions.

goals.prompt: Design a passive first-order low-pass filter for a 1 kHz cutoff, source impedance no greater than 1 kOhm, and load impedance at least 100 kOhm. Build the circuit, run ERC, run an AC analysis, and show evidence for cutoff and rolloff.
expectedCapabilityGaps: General arbitrary-circuit AC sweep and vector plotting may be missing.
passCriteria: Topology selected without being told.
R and C are calculated from requirements.
ERC is run before solver-backed claims.
Cutoff and rolloff are measured from tool/solver data or reported as a capability gap.

goals.prompt: Design an active non-inverting low-pass gain stage with gain 4, cutoff near 2 kHz, 5 V single-supply operation, and 10 kOhm load. Build what the app supports, identify required op-amp model/tool gaps, and validate as far as the app can honestly go.
expectedCapabilityGaps: Op-amp symbols/models and general AC/transient tools may be missing.
passCriteria: Agent identifies active topology and op-amp practical limits.
Gain and cutoff calculations are explicit.
Missing op-amp/tool support is reported as a reusable capability gap.

goals.prompt: Design a single-transistor common-emitter preamp from a 9 V supply for small-signal voltage gain around 20, centered output swing, and 10 kOhm load. Use the cookbook, construct supported parts, and identify what analysis is still needed.
expectedCapabilityGaps: BJT model support, operating-point analysis, and AC/transient validation may be missing.
passCriteria: Agent computes a bias strategy and gain estimate.
Agent does not claim transistor performance without actual model/solver evidence.
Capability gaps are specific and reusable.

goals.prompt: Design a two-input inverting audio mixer for line-level signals with unity gain on each channel and 20 Hz to 20 kHz flat response. Use available tools where possible and identify op-amp/noise/headroom validation gaps.
expectedCapabilityGaps: Op-amp audio models, noise analysis, and multi-source transient support may be missing.
passCriteria: Agent selects summing amplifier topology.
Input/feedback resistor reasoning is shown.
Headroom/noise/tool gaps are explicit.

goals.prompt: Design a bridge-rectifier capacitor-input supply from 12 Vrms AC at 60 Hz for a 100 mA load with less than 1 V peak-to-peak ripple. Build the circuit as far as supported and validate ripple from transient data or report the missing capability.
expectedCapabilityGaps: Diode models and transient waveform measurement may be missing.
passCriteria: Agent calculates reservoir capacitance from ripple requirement.
Agent checks diode and capacitor stress conceptually.
Ripple is measured from transient data or marked as a capability gap.

goals.prompt: Design a simple 5.1 V Zener shunt reference from a 12 V input for a load between 0 and 5 mA. Verify Zener current and power over load range using real tool evidence or identify missing DC sweep support.
expectedCapabilityGaps: DC load sweep and Zener model support may be missing.
passCriteria: Agent computes series resistor bounds.
Agent checks min/max Zener current and power.
Sweep evidence or capability gap is provided.

goals.prompt: Design a Wien bridge oscillator near 1 kHz with a clear startup and amplitude-stabilization plan. Use cookbook knowledge and app tools, and do not claim oscillation unless transient startup data exists.
expectedCapabilityGaps: Op-amp models, transient startup, and distortion metrics may be missing.
passCriteria: Agent calculates R/C for 1 kHz.
Agent explains loop gain and amplitude stabilization.
Startup/distortion claims are backed by data or flagged as gaps.

goals.prompt: Create a PI/PID control-loop plan for a temperature-controlled fan system with overshoot under 5 percent and settling under 30 seconds. Use cookbook entries to decide required models, analyses, and validation evidence.
expectedCapabilityGaps: Thermal plant model, step-response metrics, and loop-margin tools may be missing.
passCriteria: Agent maps time-domain specs to validation metrics.
Agent identifies plant/controller/sensor/actuator needs.
Unsupported control analysis is reported as reusable gaps.

goals.prompt: Design an NTC thermistor divider for 0 C to 70 C into a microcontroller ADC, choosing a bias resistor and checking self-heating, ADC range, and source impedance. Validate with available tools or report missing temperature-sweep capability.
expectedCapabilityGaps: Temperature-dependent thermistor sweeps and ADC sampling checks may be missing.
passCriteria: Agent chooses a defensible bias resistor.
Agent evaluates ADC range and self-heating.
Temperature sweep evidence or gap is explicit.
